result.preprocessor_algorithm:
NEW pure stage stages/plan_diagrams.py mirroring plan_social.py's pure-planner + sole-mutator split, ZERO client/hex/font literals, brand-agnostic by construction.

INPUTS (injected, no I/O — exactly the plan_social asset_exists pattern): structured (StructuredContent from structure_content), the package dict, plus two predicates wrapping the SHARED budget math so the planner reasons about overflow with zero I/O: copy_budget:Callable[[str],Optional[int]] (wraps ST_COPY_BUDGET_CHARS from validate_copyfit) and char_count:Callable[[dict],int] (wraps _collect_all_strings from validate_copy). occupied_zones:set[int] is injected = the set of slots plan_social already gave a visual device (scene_breather/profile_grid/case_study_post/testimonials), derived from social_plan.bindings. max_diagrams default 4.

(1) plan_diagrams(structured,*,copy_budget,char_count,occupied_zones=frozenset(),max_diagrams=4,enable=True)->DiagramPlan — PURE, deterministic. Returns DiagramPlan(bindings=[DiagramBinding...], dropped=[reason strings]) exactly like SocialPlan. DiagramBinding carries slot, kind, payload(dict), mode('replace'|'augment'), size('inline'|'band'|'full'), replace_field(Optional[str]), anchor, score.

(2) apply_diagram_plan(package,plan)->dict — the ONLY mutator, idempotent. Writes each binding onto the matching package page's data dict under key 'diagram' (the SAME key st_14.py already reads at line 100). For replace bindings it ALSO blanks/trims the named source field on the same data dict so the renderer draws the figure instead of the duplicate list (net char delta <=0). Touches no model — confirmed extra='allow' passthrough.

DETECT (per StructuredPage, run only when enable and slot not in occupied_zones and structured_page.charts is EMPTY — the global guard: a diagram never competes with a real ChartSpec the renderer will draw; charts present => defer, record nothing). Detectors, gated on the TYPED data model fields (German+English signal sets, no client literals): (a) BEFORE/AFTER — ComparisonData.compare {ohne[],mit[]} non-empty, OR a 2-item stat list with before/after label TOKENS (reuse structure_content._BEFORE_TOKENS/_AFTER_TOKENS); (b) PROCESS — an ORDERED list: CollabStep with n set, MechanismData.steps, or items whose titles carry numeric/ordinal prefixes; (c) TRIAD — EXACTLY 3 short (<~60 char) enumeration items (beliefs/symptoms) AND a real unifying line present (title/these/key_insight) for the center; (d) Q&A — FaqData.faqs of {frage,antwort}, 3-6 items; (e) STAT_CALLOUT — exactly one real figure matched by the regex family r'\d{1,3}\s*[-–]\s*\d{1,3}\s*%|\d{1,3}\s*%|\d+\s*[x×]|\d+\s*von\s*\d+' in ergebnis/ergebnis_text/body. Each detector returns a candidate or None; too-few/too-long items => no candidate.

SELECT (fixed deterministic PRIORITY ladder, like plan_social allocation order): 1 before_after_columns, 2 process_flow, 3 convergence_triad, 4 q_a_ladder, 5 stat_callout (lowest — augments, never replaces). TIE-BREAK 1 shape gates beat priority: process_flow only beats triad when an ordering signal exists; a 3-item UNORDERED list + synthesis => triad even though flow ranks higher; a 4-6 item ordered list can never be a triad => process_flow. TIE-BREAK 2 ST-type affinity (static table, no client literal): ST-06/ST-22->process_flow, ST-14->convergence_triad, ST-07B->before_after_columns, ST-08->q_a_ladder, ST-09->triad-or-stat_callout. TIE-BREAK 3 overflow value: prefer the type that replaces the most prose. Final tie-break: element name ascending. AT MOST ONE diagram per page. NEVER a host: ST-01/ST-03 (CTA/cover) and ST-31/ST-32 (breathers, budget 350) — excluded up front like plan_social excludes cards.

PLACE: each binding gets mode + size. REPLACE (default for before_after/process_flow/triad/q_a) carries replace_field; the applier sets data['diagram'] AND blanks/trims that field; size by item count (3->band, 4-6->band/full, triad->band). AUGMENT (stat_callout only) floats a card from a figure already in prose; size 'inline', text-neutral. anchor='after_intro' default or 'replace:<field>'; the per-ST template owns exact vertical position (st_14 already places .fb-diagram after the intro). Global scarcity: rank candidates by descending detection-strength score then ascending slot, take max_diagrams; excess => plan.dropped 'deck diagram budget reached'.

NO-FABRICATION GUARDS: every node label/step title/column item/question/center phrase is COPIED VERBATIM from the typed field that triggered detection — the planner only selects/reorders existing strings, never authors. Numbers are matched and rendered verbatim, never computed (same discipline as CostMathStrip). convergence_triad fires ONLY with EXACTLY 3 short items AND a genuine synthesis line; no synthesis => degrade to next priority or omit ('no synthesis line for triad center'). before_after uses only literal ohne/mit lists.

OVERFLOW SAFETY (three layered guarantees, all keyed off the INJECTED copy_budget/char_count so the planner shares the gate's exact math, and the stage runs BEFORE validate_copyfit): (1) REPLACE-not-add — post-apply char_count <= pre-apply, strictly reduces copy; (2) AUGMENT is text-neutral — stat_callout reuses a figure already counted; (3) PRE-CHECK with headroom — projected_chars = char_count(data) minus replaced-field chars; if a budget exists and projected_chars > budget*0.95, DOWNGRADE (replace a larger field, fall to text-neutral stat_callout, else omit with a plan.dropped reason). Net: monotone non-increasing copy interaction; the diagram can only ever reduce overflow risk. Single-band figures (one flow row, one Venn, one callout card) bound vertical height too.

gap_audit: FABRICATION RISK — the planner could invent a synthesis center or reclassify two unrelated numbers into a before/after. MITIGATION: every label is copied verbatim from the typed field that triggered detection; convergence_triad requires EXACTLY 3 short items AND a real unifying line (title/these/key_insight) or it degrades; before_after uses only literal ohne/mit lists; stat_callout renders the matched figure verbatim, never computed — identical discipline to structure_content._before_after_from_stats and charts_svg CostMathStrip.

OVERFLOW RISK — adding a visual band could push a ~20-page text deck over budget. MITIGATION: REPLACE mode removes the prose list the diagram visualizes (net char delta <=0); AUGMENT (stat_callout) reuses an already-counted figure (text-neutral); the stage runs BEFORE validate_copyfit and pre-checks projected_chars against budget*0.95 using the SAME injected char_count/copy_budget the gate uses, downgrading or omitting near the ceiling. Monotone non-increasing by construction.

DOUBLE-RENDER RISK — a diagram could compete with a real ChartSpec on the same page. MITIGATION: global guard — a page is a candidate ONLY if structured_page.charts is empty; charts present => defer silently (not a drop). Also occupied_zones (from social_plan.bindings) skips any slot plan_social already gave a photo device, keeping one hero device per page.

BRAND-AGNOSTIC GUARD RISK — the existing generate_components ST-builders use hardcoded hex (#3d3d4a); a new diagram path could regress the token discipline. MITIGATION: every new macro/CSS is token-only (var(--…)/color-mix), no hex/font/client literal; the planner module contains only ST-type-affinity + field-name signal tables (German+English), exactly like structure_content._OHNE_KEYS and plan_social role frozensets; the brand-agnostic guard test covers the new files.

CHROMIUM vs WEASYPRINT RISK — the premium look uses gradients/box-shadow/glow. MITIGATION: hard constraint confirms Chromium print-to-PDF honors gradients/box-shadow/blur/glow; WeasyPrint silently ignores box-shadow/text-shadow (renders flat, losslessly) — the .c-venn comment + the existing DEPTH SYSTEM (components.css line 1162) already rely on this. We avoid backdrop-filter (does not work). mm geometry is preserved for print fidelity.

REAL-DATA SCARCITY ON APEX — the highest-value hosts are starved on the apex fixture: ST-07B compare is null on all 3 slots (8/10/13), ST-08 (FAQ) is absent from the 20-page deck, and ST-09 symptoms are 6 long-body items (too long for a triad). MITIGATION: the algorithm degrades gracefully — on apex it fires only where real data supports it (Venn on ST-14, process_flow on ST-06/ST-22, stat_callout on ST-09/ST-FAZIT/ST-02); before_after_columns and q_a_ladder ship as forward-looking hosts for clients whose report generator emits ohne/mit and faqs. This is the same emitter/extractor-alignment gap already noted for charts; the diagram path is additive and never blocks.

DETERMINISM RISK — non-deterministic selection would break golden snapshots. MITIGATION: fixed priority ladder + 3 ordered tie-breaks + final element-name-ascending tiebreak + bindings.sort by (slot,element), identical to plan_social's deterministic output contract.

ITEM-LENGTH / WRAP RISK — a process_flow band of 6 steps with long bodies could overflow the lower-third band. MITIGATION: size is chosen by item count; the band caps at ~35% page height per Richard's sizing rule; titles are short and step bodies are optional/truncated in the flow macro (the full prose stays available because flow titles use _flow_title, as st_06 already does). For >6 items the page degrades to prose (no diagram).
